verdict: Skydo's worst alternatives page: 13 citations from 57 fetches (0.23) against Xflow's 0.79. The Stripe question is about three different jobs, card checkout in India (Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU), merchant of record for global SaaS (Paddle, Dodo), and invoice collection (Skydo, Wise, Xflow). Xflow's page is organised by those three jobs and names all ten brands. Skydo's page lists PayPal, Wise, Payoneer and remittance apps, none of which is a Stripe substitute for anyone, and has no Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU or Paddle. The one thing ChatGPT does lift from it is Skydo's own line about being for invoices rather than checkout.

diagnosis: 'Stripe alternatives' is three questions in one: an Indian gateway, a merchant of record, or an invoice-collection account. Xflow's page is organised by those three jobs; Skydo's page answers only the third and pads it with PayPal, Payoneer and remittance apps.
The brands ChatGPT names (Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU, Paddle, Adyen) are absent from Skydo's page, so the page can contribute at most one row.

The gateway-versus-receiving-account sentence is the citation Skydo gets. It exists on Skydo's page only as a pain point about Stripe; on Xflow's page it is a stated evaluation criterion repeated under every gateway.
G2 ratings and dated regulatory facts per brand are quotable; Skydo's page has none of the former.

Retrieval is also low (57 fetches) because the title promises 'Stripe alternatives for Indian exporters' and the fanouts ask for payment processors and gateways; the compare page does not match the global half of the query at all.
The shared compare template is the wrong shape for this query even if its defects were fixed. This page needs a different brand list, not only a different layout.
Skydo's Stripe facts (invite-only, card-only, 6.3%, no FIRA) are good and should survive the rebuild.
spec: Rebuild as a 10-brand listicle grouped by job: Indian gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU), merchant of record (Paddle, Dodo Payments, Lemon Squeezy), invoice collection (Skydo, Wise, Xflow, Infinity). Drop PayPal, remittance apps and SWIFT.
State the three-job distinction in the opening paragraph and in a 'how we evaluated' block; repeat it in each brand's cons.
Text-header comparison table with a fee summary, best for, and G2 rating per brand; a second table with net on $1,000 and $5,000 for the collection platforms.
Keep Skydo's Stripe pain points (invite-only, card-only, 6.3% effective, no FIRA) as the 'why people leave' block.
